100cims-page.hero-subtitle: The app to track your progress on the 100 Cims challenge and dozens of other summit lists across Catalonia and the world. Free, iOS and Android.
100cims-page.what-is-p1: Climbing the 100 Cims is a Catalan hiking tradition: a curated list of one hundred representative peaks inviting you to discover the country on foot. From easy hills that take a few hours to Pyrenean summits above 3,000 metres, the list covers the whole Catalan territory.
100cims-page.what-is-p2: Cims, sempre amunt is an app that makes tracking your ascents simple. You mark summits as done, add a photo and date, and watch your progress grow. Beyond the 100 Cims, you'll find many other challenges like Sostres Comarcals, Essential Peaks, Top Spain and more.
100cims-page.step-1-body: Available free on the App Store and Google Play. No complicated signup — log in with Apple or Google and you're ready.
100cims-page.step-2-body: Choose the 100 Cims challenge or any other available list. You can follow several challenges at once and switch between them whenever you want.
100cims-page.step-3-body: When you reach the summit, open the app, add a photo and the date. Your progress updates automatically and you can share it with whoever you want.
100cims-page.featured-title: Some of the peaks you'll find
100cims-page.featured-subtitle: A small sample from the catalog — inside the app you'll find hundreds of peaks with complete info, map and route.
100cims-page.faq-1-a: The 100 Cims are a popular curated list of one hundred representative mountains of Catalonia. They include peaks from every region with varied difficulty, designed so anyone motivated can complete the challenge at their own pace.
100cims-page.faq-2-a: No. Cims, sempre amunt is an independent passion project. It has no affiliation with FEEC (Federació d'Entitats Excursionistes de Catalunya) or any federation. For official validation such as the FEEC diploma, you need to arrange it with them directly.
100cims-page.faq-3-q: How much does the app cost?
100cims-page.faq-3-a: The app is completely free. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. The project is supported by voluntary donations from users who want to help.
100cims-page.faq-4-q: Which platforms is it available on?
100cims-page.faq-4-a: iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android. Download it from the App Store or Google Play.
100cims-page.faq-5-q: What about summits I did before installing the app?
100cims-page.faq-5-a: You can log ascents retroactively. In each summit form you can set the real date you climbed it and add a photo if you have one. Your progress recalculates automatically.
100cims-page.faq-6-q: Are there challenges beyond the 100 Cims?
100cims-page.faq-6-a: Yes. Beyond the 100 Cims you'll find Sostres Comarcals, Essential Peaks, Top Spain, Cumbres Astures, Altos Madrileños and others. Follow as many as you want — the same ascent counts for every challenge that contains it.
100cims-page.faq-7-a: The app runs on trust: you log your own ascents with photo and date. There's no mandatory GPS check or external validation. It's a personal tracking tool, not an official competition.
100cims-page.disclaimer: Cims, sempre amunt is not affiliated with or endorsed by FEEC or any federation.
100cims-page.cta-subtitle: Install the app, pick your challenge and start logging your summits. Free, ad-free, made by hikers.
